review_method: Separate deterministic acceptance audit in tests/test_pilot_lens.py against the lens schema and repository evidence boundaries.

evidence.source_review: Five dated, HTTPS, primary authored posts are identified; every claim resolves to at least one of their stable source IDs.
evidence.confidence_review: The lens is restricted to prompt injection and agent security; repeated direct statements are high confidence and the sole synthesis claim is labeled inference at medium confidence.
evidence.copyright_boundary_review: Only source metadata and original paraphrases are stored; there are no excerpts, mirrored pages, transcripts, article hashes, or copied diagrams.
evidence.validity_window_review: The immutable snapshot is dated 2026-09-07 and expires after 90 days on 2026-12-06; all source publication and retrieval dates are on or before the snapshot date.

residual_limits: This review verifies the repository artifact and cited authored-source metadata; it does not claim endorsement or comprehensive coverage of Simon Willison's work.
The snapshot should abstain outside its narrow LLM application-security scope.
